internetOutageMeta.caveat: IODA detections describe macroscopic Internet connectivity change, not causal attribution, intent, a proven shutdown, or the connectivity of any particular user or facility. Coordinates are broad Natural Earth reference placements rather than outage origins or spatial footprints. An empty result is not an all-clear; an end equal to the query horizon is clipped/ambiguous and establishes neither recovery nor continuing outage.
